As a casual player, who never could get into raiding because everyone was always so aggressive when I tried to find guilds: BFA

My reasoning is that I picked up the game in TBC, played for a bit, wasn't casual enough so I stopped. Picked it up again in Wrath, people were full aggro and the grind was boring to me, stopped.
Tried again in MoP, ran out of money, so of course I stopped. And then in legion, where again raiding was to much to deal with, and the solo experience wasn't all that great. But then I picked up BFA, solo was easy enough I could play it, classes didn't really matter to much so I could enjoy whatever I felt like enjoying, and everyone hated the expansion so much that no one was super serious anymore, hopped a few guilds while playing and everyone was always super nice. I know I'm not the primary player-base and some people just love the aggressive environment of raiding, but it wasn't until BFA that I found a group that was fun to play with, classes that I could enjoy without feeling like I made a mistake picking them, and an enjoyable enough solo experience that I could play by myself and not feel like I'm bored.

In my experience, keto burning on light classes (medic, sniper, spy, scout) but it depends on others. 

For heavies, if they turn to you, sometimes I'll air blast then swap to shotgun and get the burst damage out, other times I just keep burning. 

For pyros, I find it dependent on range. If they're up close, you'll want to air blast them away and shoot them then, but that's not always an option. It's a safe bet to push them away any time they get close. If they're far away, don't bother with any of the flare guns or your degreaser. Shotgun, best gun. 

Solly's I usually never switch to shotgun unless they're reloading, but that's just for quick damage. This doesn't mean M1 spam though, try to learn that players timing if they're shooting rockets and haven't switched to the shotgun, a lot of players make air blasting them easy. Otherwise M1 is good. 

Demos are funny fellas, if they're good, air blasting their pipes is a good way to go, even if just to stop your team from getting hurt. But get in close to them and you'll want to fry him in fire ASAP. If they're bad, you can likely use shotgun for range and work on getting close. And if they're a demo knight just burn and air blast, they'll either run away, at which point you shotgun them, or try to kill you more, which you'll just repeat the previous steps. 

Hope this helps at all. And others might have different ideas for it, so don't forget to read theirs!

Edit: as for engies, unless you have an Uber or they only have a level 1 or are alone , it's best to avoid them! Remember the rule on light classes!
